inflict_fear.title: Inflict Fear
inflict_fear.description: Inflict fear to others for 10 second making them hear things that doesn't exist

ringconstruction.title: Ring Construction
ringconstruction.description: This final ability allows you to create a duplicate of your current ring at the cost of all your fear. Once used, the ability becomes locked. Note: You must have Fear Max lvl 3

first_tick_commands: execute as @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^3 run function final_lanterns:yellowlanternconstruction
execute if entity @e[type=#final_lanterns:hostile_prey,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..10] run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 3 1 true
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^5 run effect give @e[type=!#final_lanterns:not_creatures,tag=!gl_user,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..6] minecraft:darkness 8 1 true
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^5 run effect give @e[type=!#final_lanterns:not_creatures,tag=!gl_user,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..6] minecraft:slowness 8 1 true
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^5 run effect give @e[type=!#final_lanterns:not_creatures,tag=!gl_user,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..6] minecraft:weakness 8 1 true

execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^5 as @e[type=!#final_lanterns:not_creatures,tag=!gl_user,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..6] at @s run particle minecraft:squid_ink ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.5 0.3 0.02 15 force
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^5 as @a[tag=!gl_user,distance=..6] run title @s title {"text": "Don't you hear him?", "color": "yellow", "italic": true}

execute as @e[type=!#final_lanterns:not_creatures,tag=!gl_user,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..12,limit=1,sort=nearest] if entity @s[type=minecraft:player] run title @s title {"text": "Don't you hear him?", "color": "yellow", "italic": true}
